g.text: Both tests say the same thing: the far end sets the pace
Right-hand panel uses --whole-file in both arms, so every byte crosses the wire either way and only the far side's page allocation differs.
Windows: Dell Latitude 7490, i5-8350U (4 cores / 8 threads, 15 W) · Linux: Ryzen 7 PRO 7840U (16 threads) · Thunderbolt networking, MTU 65330, link 20 Gbit/s
